easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
